mapper.select: select SEQ_NO, TASK_NAME, PRD_GROUP_SEQ_NO, STATUS, LAST_TIME, START_TIME, END_TIME, BUSI_DATE, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME from SYS_UNACCOUNTANT_INFO where STATUS = '0' OR STATUS = '1'

select t.SEQ_NO, t.TASK_NAME, t.PRD_GROUP_SEQ_NO, t.STATUS, t.LAST_TIME, t.START_TIME, t.END_TIME, t.BUSI_DATE, t.REMARK, t.CREATE_USER, t.CREATE_DEPT, t.CREATE_TIME, t.UPDATE_USER, t.UPDATE_TIME from SYS_UNACCOUNTANT_INFO t where STATUS = '0' OR STATUS = '1'

select t.SEQ_NO, t.EXECTASK_ID, t.MODEL_CODE, t.ORDER_NO, t.STATUS, t.LAST_TIME, t.START_TIME, t.END_TIME, t.BUSI_DATE, t.REMARK, t.CREATE_USER, t.CREATE_DEPT, t.CREATE_TIME, t.UPDATE_USER, t.UPDATE_TIME from SYS_UNACCOUNTANT_INFO_DETAIL t where SEQ_NO = #{seqno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STATUS = '0'

select t.SEQ_NO, t.EXECTASK_ID, t.MODEL_CODE, t.ORDER_NO, t.STATUS, t.LAST_TIME, t.START_TIME, t.END_TIME, t.BUSI_DATE, t.REMARK, t.CREATE_USER, t.CREATE_DEPT, t.CREATE_TIME, t.UPDATE_USER, t.UPDATE_TIME from SYS_UNACCOUNTANT_INFO_DETAIL t where (STATUS = '0' OR STATUS = '1') AND SEQ_NO = #{seqno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ORDER_NO < #{orderNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

select t.SEQ_NO, t.EXECTASK_ID, t.MODEL_CODE, t.ORDER_NO, t.STATUS, t.LAST_TIME, t.START_TIME, t.END_TIME, t.BUSI_DATE, t.REMARK, t.CREATE_USER, t.CREATE_DEPT, t.CREATE_TIME, t.UPDATE_USER, t.UPDATE_TIME from SYS_UNACCOUNTANT_INFO_DETAIL t where STATUS = '3' AND SEQ_NO = #{seqno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ORDER_NO = #{orderNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.update: update SYS_UNACCOUNTANT_INFO set STATUS='1' WHERE 1=1 AND SEQ_NO = #{seqno, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select:
SELECT distinct grp.task_grp_id taskGrpId, grp.task_grp_name taskGrpName, grp.p_task_grp_id pTaskGrpId, task.TASK_ID taskId, task.FTASK_ID ftaskId, task.BEAN_NAME beanName, task.TASK_NAME taskName, task.TASK_PRI taskPri, task.CREATE_USER createUser, task.CREATE_TIME createTime, task.UPDATE_USER updateUser, task.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, grp.order_no orderNo FROM bok_batch_task_grp grp left join SYS_BATCH_TASK task on grp.task_id=task.task_id where 1=1
and grp.task_Grp_Type=#{taskGrpType}
start with (UPPER(grp.task_grp_name) LIKE concat(concat('%', UPPER(#{batchName})),'%') OR UPPER(grp.task_grp_name) LIKE concat(concat('%', UPPER(#{batchName})),'%') )
connect by prior grp.p_task_grp_id = task_grp_id order by grp.order_no,grp.task_grp_id

select SEQNO, BUSI_DATE, ORDERNO, TASK_ENAME, START_TIME, END_TIME, STATUS, EXEC_RESULT, LAST_TIME, DETAIL_ACTION, EXECTASK_SEQNO FROM VAL_INTERF_ACTIONLOG WHERE EXECTASK_SEQNO = #{execId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select s.SEQ_NO seqNo, s.SYSTEM_CODE systemCode, s.BATCH_EXEDETAIL_SEQ_NO batchExedetailSeqNo, s.BEAN_NAME beanName, s.TASK_ID taskId, s.EXECUTE_DATE executeDate, s.START_MODE startMode, s.TASK_STATUS taskStatus, s.CREATE_USER createUser, s.CREATE_TIME createTime,
s.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, s.UPDATE_USER updateUser FROM SYS_BATCH_EXEC_INFO s WHERE s.BATCH_EXEDETAIL_SEQ_NO IN ( SELECT SEQ_NO FROM SYS_BATCHGRP_EXEC_INFO D WHERE D.OTHER_PARAM3 = #{execId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) and s.batch_exedetail_seq_no != #{execId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: update SYS_UNACCOUNTANT_INFO set status = '3', END_TIME = #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, LAST_TIME = #{lastTime, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE SEQ_NO = #{seqno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STATUS = '1'
mapper.select:
select task_Id taskId from sys_batch_job where 1=1
and BATCH_SEQ_NO in('6f8803b3aa6fbaffe050007f01003cad','71d2d76a4f5d2ff2e050007f01000e70','71d2edea97deace9e050007f01001581')

select SEQNO,busiDate,startTime,endTime,status,detailAction,taskCname,lastTime from ( SELECT LOG.SEQNO,to_char(LOG.BUSI_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') busiDate,LOG.START_TIME startTime,LOG.END_TIME endTime ,DECODE(LOG.STATUS,'02',DECODE(nvl(logDetail.ERROR,0),0,'02','09'),LOG.STATUS) status ,DECODE(LOG.STATUS,'02',DECODE(nvl(logDetail.ERROR,0),0,'执行成功'||nvl(logDetail.success,0)||'条','执行成功'||nvl(logDetail.success,0)||'条,失败'||nvl(logDetail.ERROR,0)||'条'),LOG.DETAIL_ACTION) detailAction1 ,ta.TASK_NAME taskCname,ROUND(LOG.LAST_TIME/1000,2) lastTime ,LOG.EXEC_RESULT detailAction FROM VAL_INTERF_ACTIONLOG LOG left join VAL_INTERF_TASK ta on ta.BEAN_NAME=LOG.TASK_ENAME LEFT JOIN( SELECT a.parent_seqno,sum(a.success) success,sum(a.ERROR) ERROR FROM ( SELECT parent_seqno parent_seqno, DECODE(VAL.IS_CHECK,'Y',LENGHT) success,DECODE(VAL.IS_CHECK,'N',LENGHT) ERROR from ( SELECT parent_seqno,IS_CHECK,COUNT(1) LENGHT FROM VAL_INTERFLOG WHERE 1=1 group by parent_seqno,IS_CHECK) val) a group by parent_seqno
) logDetail ON LOG.Seqno=logDetail.parent_seqno WHERE 1=1
AND LOG.EXECTASK_SEQNO = #{execId} ) logdetail WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY busiDate
